notes: This artifact records planning policy decisions only; it does not call providers, crawl sources, change UI, or affect runtime safety behavior.
The initial Phase 4 implementation decisions are resolved as candidate-only, fixture-backed policies; future field-trial thresholds can still be tightened with new decisions.

constraints: Primary mountain calibration remains fixture-backed.
Does not imply live provider sync or runtime mutation.
resolved_decisions.resolution: Use Chilai-Nanhua / Nenggao Day 1 as the primary mountain calibration case for Phase 4.
resolved_decisions.summary: The first mountain calibration fixture is Chilai-Nanhua Day 1.
resolved_decisions.title: Primary mountain calibration fixture

constraints: Regression fixture is secondary to the Chilai mountain calibration case.
Raw local capture payloads remain outside this decision register.
resolved_decisions.resolution: Keep scout_260512 as the field-data-to-fixtures regression project in the Phase 4 fixture matrix.
resolved_decisions.summary: The Scout 260512 project is a regression fixture, not the primary mountain calibration case.
resolved_decisions.title: Scout 260512 regression fixture

constraints: Do not commit raw DTM rasters as planning fixtures.
Fixture JSON may carry metadata and reduced summaries only.
resolved_decisions.resolution: DTM remains metadata-only for Phase 4 fixtures; raw DTM stays local/offline.
resolved_decisions.summary: Terrain evidence can reference DTM metadata and reduced summaries but not raw rasters.
resolved_decisions.title: DTM metadata-only treatment

constraints: Return-to-entry is a planning candidate/policy ref, not a live runtime override.
Future alternate/retreat policy can still tighten readiness separately.
resolved_decisions.resolution: Use a return-to-entry retreat route candidate for the initial Chilai Phase 4 package.
resolved_decisions.summary: The initial retreat treatment is a return-to-entry candidate rather than a separate live runtime path.
resolved_decisions.title: Return-to-entry retreat route

constraints: Joyhike and PTT references support planning context and timing candidates.
They do not become authoritative runtime facts without review.
resolved_decisions.resolution: Treat Joyhike and PTT as source-linked planning references, not as crawler-backed or authoritative live inputs.
resolved_decisions.summary: Joyhike/PTT are preserved as provenance-backed reference material for the fixture.
resolved_decisions.title: Joyhike/PTT source treatment

constraints: Timing fields can be absent when the source does not provide them.
Unknown timing basis must remain explicit in downstream artifacts.
resolved_decisions.resolution: Keep route-guide timing fields optional where source material is incomplete.
resolved_decisions.summary: Timing candidates may carry optional fields instead of forcing invented precision.
resolved_decisions.title: Optional timing fields

constraints: UI reads fixture-backed Phase 4 planning artifacts only.
Review/edit toolbar controls remain disabled until a later explicit write-path slice.
No Phase 1 live runtime mutation or safety API call is allowed.
resolved_decisions.resolution: Start Milestone 7 with a fixture-backed read-only admin preview UI.
resolved_decisions.summary: The first Phase 4 UI slice is read-only and evidence-driven.
resolved_decisions.title: Fixture-backed read-only admin UI

constraints: No POI category absence can become a blocker or warning.
The policy remains candidate-only and does not mutate hard readiness.
resolved_decisions.resolution: Use an admin-parameterizable route-corridor POI coverage rule: default 1000m corridor distance, minimum 1 POI, warning severity, and no category-specific blocker/warning findings.
resolved_decisions.summary: POI category absence is not a blocker or warning; only missing POI coverage near the route corridor can warn.
resolved_decisions.title: POI route-corridor coverage policy

constraints: No live weather API dependency in core tests.
Threshold references do not imply authoritative or reviewed weather.
resolved_decisions.resolution: Use CWA-style reference thresholds for rain, fog, wind, and dark-arrival margin as optional configurable policy fields; fixture evidence remains placeholder/manual and human-review-required.
resolved_decisions.summary: Weather/daylight evidence carries configurable CWA-style threshold references while remaining candidate-only until reviewed.
resolved_decisions.title: Weather/daylight quantitative threshold references

constraints: Contour interpretation must not become ObservedFact.
Raw image or raster payloads must not be embedded in fixture JSON.
resolved_decisions.resolution: Represent contour interpretation as candidate-only AI-assisted or manual-baseline records with an admin-review lifecycle; accepted planning assumptions require HumanReview.
resolved_decisions.summary: Contour interpretation uses AI-assisted candidates followed by admin review for final decisions.
resolved_decisions.title: AI-assisted contour review lifecycle

constraints: Comparison routes are not authoritative for the mission package.
Raw external GPX is not committed as a fixture without explicit redistributable source approval.
resolved_decisions.resolution: Keep route comparison output metadata-only: hash, bbox, distance, point deltas, and source-use treatment flags; raw external GPX is not versioned, not authoritative, and not compiled into MissionGraph.
resolved_decisions.summary: External comparison GPX sources are treated as derived summaries only unless redistributable fixture rights are reviewed later.
resolved_decisions.title: Route comparison derived-summary-only treatment

constraints: Decision log rows are append-only review records.
No source artifact, pre-trip package, runtime state, Phase 2 Brain state, or MissionGraph output is mutated.
No raw source payloads or external API calls are embedded in the fixture.
resolved_decisions.resolution: Use a fixture-only review decision log for Phase 4 review outcomes: append-only, no package/runtime/Brain mutation, and no MissionGraph compile.
resolved_decisions.summary: Review outcomes can be recorded as fixture-backed decision-log metadata without applying them to runtime or compiled mission artifacts.
resolved_decisions.title: Fixture-only append-only review decision log

constraints: Requests store URL and intent metadata only.
No fetch, crawler, scrape, snapshot, or raw remote payload is allowed in this slice.
Requested items remain Artifact/planning-reference candidates until human review.
resolved_decisions.resolution: Model the external import queue as URL/request-only metadata: no fetch, no crawler, no raw payload, and no authoritative Artifact until human review accepts a planning-reference candidate.
resolved_decisions.summary: External references are queued as pending human-review requests rather than imported source content.
resolved_decisions.title: URL-only external import queue

constraints: POI policy, remote contact summary, weather/daylight thresholds, contour treatment, and route comparison source treatment are closed by existing resolved decisions.
Crawler/live write-path work remains out of scope unless separately approved.
Closed backlog decisions do not imply network, crawler, package mutation, runtime mutation, Brain mutation, or MissionGraph compile behavior.
resolved_decisions.resolution: Close the current Backlog / Next Decisions policy set as resolved: route-corridor POI coverage only, remote contact summary present, weather/daylight thresholds optional configurable reference data, contour interpretation AI-assisted candidates plus admin review, and route comparison derived-summary-only.
resolved_decisions.summary: The previously open Phase 4 admin backlog policy questions are now recorded as resolved scope decisions.
resolved_decisions.title: Current backlog policy set closed
